decisions.reason: It remains a specialized but clearly core spraying solution for corrosion-protection work, and after surviving its first market year it still fits the firm's customized application portfolio well.
As a multi-model material transfer pump line in the firm's core handling equipment business, it likely benefits from meaningful product-family investment and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump and spray products, it supports the firm's move toward more digital, interoperable customer solutions, so we would keep it unless demand stays clearly below expectations.
Given its very recent launch and close fit with the established two-component spraying business, it would normally be given more time to build traction before any withdrawal decision.
